en.title: Mobile, Internet or Subscription Billing Dispute
en.directAnswer: Start with the provider’s bill and package terms. Save SMS messages, app screens, usage records and payment proof. Ask the provider to explain the charge in writing. If the problem is not resolved, use the relevant sector regulator or consumer complaint route where applicable.

atAGlance.whoFor: A customer says a telecom or subscription charge is wrong.

Escalate to the sector complaint route.

evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
